messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - dedicated-pool: astraform-prod-dedicated-01 reports GPU fabric errors for tenant astraform (ast-233). Error rate spiked 2026-11-02T03:12Z. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Please acknowledge.

maya (oncall-sre): ack - taking. Posting initial triage.

maya (oncall-sre): quick summary: NVLink/fabric errors on 3 of 8 GPUs on node gpu-node-47 (pool astraform-prod-dedicated-01). Symptoms: increased retries, some 502s from the runtime, token latencies up ~4-6x. Not a full pool outage but degraded for that tenant's high-qps routes.

vikram (eng-runtime): do we know whether this is a spot eviction or hardware fault? Any logs from nvidia-smi / driver?

samir (hardware-ops): looks like hardware-level fabric parity errors. From node console: 
```
[2026-11-02T03:10:31Z] NVLINK(ERR): fabric_parity_error channel 2
[2026-11-02T03:10:32Z] NVML: GPU 2 ECC_NONFATAL 1 -> threshold exceeded
[2026-11-02T03:11:00Z] THERMAL: GPU2 temp spike to 92C; fans at 100%
```
Not a spot termination. Filing hw ticket HW-2129.

maya (oncall-sre): thanks Samir. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain gpu-node-47 from the pool, 2) fail over tenant traffic to astraform-prod-dedicated-02 if capacity permits, 3) enable hosted fallback for non-critical routes, 4) notify customer success/account. Executing drain now.

maya (oncall-sre): run: ```poolctl pool drain --pool astraform-prod-dedicated-01 --node gpu-node-47 --reason "NVLINK fabric parity" --max-grace 60s```
output: ```drain initiated for gpu-node-47
active requests migrating: 12
force-terminate after 60s
node marked DRAINING
```

jess (support): customer support reports error spike from Astraform's monitoring: 502s and occasional truncated responses. They are sending an internal alert to the Astraform SRE and CC'd our account team.

olivia (cust-eng): on call with Astraform now. They're seeing degraded latency on their fraud-detection pipeline hitting /v1/chat. They want ETA for full restore and whether data isolation is impacted.

maya (oncall-sre): message for Astraform: "We're draining one degraded host in your dedicated pool and migrating active sessions. No tenant data left the pool; this is a hardware fault. We expect migration + node replacement to complete in ~40-60m. We'll keep high-priority routes routed to your backup dedicated pool, and non-critical batch traffic will failover to hosted instances if needed."

vikram (eng-runtime): creating canary routing rule: route 100% of priority paths (fraud-detector) to astraform-prod-dedicated-02 and enable 30% of other traffic to hosted-fallback with cache warming. Command: ```rdctl routing update --tenant ast-233 --policy canary --from astraform-prod-dedicated-01:all --to astraform-prod-dedicated-02:priority,hosted-fallback:spill=30```
rdctl output: ```route update accepted; effecting changes now; expected convergence ~20s```

maya (oncall-sre): observing migration: active inflight drops from 12 -> 3 -> 0. Runtime logs show requests being routed to pool-02. Latency for priority paths returning to normal range for now.

samir (hardware-ops): hwops will swap the GPU board and re-run burn-in. ETA replacement crew on-site: 45m. Preparing spare parts.

kyle (oncall-ml): note: model KV caches will empty on moved tasks; recommend warming with one-shot warmup requests for top prompt templates. I'll post curl examples to warm caches.

kyle (oncall-ml): warmup snippet: ```for p in $(cat top-prompts.txt); do curl -s -X POST $ENDPOINT -d "{\"input\":\"$p\"}" & done```

maya (oncall-sre): performed warmups to pool-02; token throughput normalized. Asking account to validate.

olivia (cust-eng): Astraform confirms latency for fraud-detector route is back to acceptable (p95 ~ 120ms). They still see some 502s on low-priority batch jobs; will rerun. Thanks for the fast failover.

jess (support): I've opened Support-5418 to track customer SLA impact. Noting impacted window: 2026-11-02T03:10Z - ongoing. Will add postmortem link when complete.

maya (oncall-sre): handoff: I'm going to run through the replace steps with Samir and then hand to Vikram for post-replacement verification. Vikram, if you pick this up, please verify perf counters and finalize routing back to pool-01 once healthy.

vikram (eng-runtime): taking post-replace. Checklist I'll run after Samir finishes swap: 1) run nvml diagnostics, 2) run 30m load generator, 3) ensure no more fabric parity errors for 1h, 4) uncordon node then migrate small percentage of traffic for 10m, 5) scale to full.

samir (hardware-ops): replacement done at 03:50Z, performed burn-in. Logs after swap: ```NVLINK: OK
THERMAL: stable GPU temps 46-58C
NVML: no ECC events in last 5m```

maya (oncall-sre): running nvml diags: ```nvmlDeviceGetAllClockInfo OK
nvmlDeviceGetMemoryErrorCounter: 0
runtime health: GREEN```

vikram (eng-runtime): starting controlled uncordon and traffic shift: ```poolctl node uncordon gpu-node-47 --drain-check 10m
rdctl routing update --tenant ast-233 --policy revert --from astraform-prod-dedicated-02:priority,hosted-fallback:spill=30 --to astraform-prod-dedicated-01:all```
convergence looks clean. Monitoring p95/p99 both stable.

olivia (cust-eng): Astraform confirms full functionality restored for all routes. They request a short post-incident note and ETA for hardware root cause investigation. I'll coordinate with Samir on RCA.

jess (support): Support-5418 updated: customer impact window closed at 2026-11-02T03:52Z. No billing adjustments requested at this time; they will review.

maya (oncall-sre): closing actions: - attach HW ticket HW-2129 to incident - create postmortem draft with timeline + mitigations (maya) - follow up on stronger NVLink monitoring and auto-shed policy for high-temp events (vikram + samir) - notify ops-route that pool replacement complete.

samir (hardware-ops): RCA note to add: faulty NVLink interposer; replacement fixed. Will propose quarterly NVLink stress test for dedicated pools.

kyle (oncall-ml): suggest adding route-level cache grace for dedicated tenants to reduce customer user impact during host drains. Filing RFC.

maya (oncall-sre): incident status: resolved. Summary: hardware NVLink parity errors on gpu-node-47 in astraform-prod-dedicated-01 caused degraded traffic; drained node, replaced GPU board, validated, and reintroduced to pool. Customer had temporary latency/502s window ~42m. Will produce postmortem. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
